title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG AND PASSEPARTOUT ACCEPT EACH OTHER, THE ONE AS MASTER, THE OTHER AS MAN
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg, an enigmatic and exceedingly punctual English gentleman, hires a new French servant named Jean Passepartout to maintain his strict daily routine.
summary_detail: In 1872 London, the mysterious and wealthy Phileas Fogg lives a solitary, mathematically precise life revolving around his home at Saville Row and the Reform Club. After firing his previous servant for bringing shaving water that was two degrees too cold, he interviews and hires Jean Passepartout. Passepartout is a Frenchman seeking a quiet, stable life after a varied career, and he gladly accepts the rigid schedule of his new master.
